text:
Sam: RFC follow-up  proposal: normalize a tiny set of obs headers at the edge so downstream cost and sampling logic has a single source of truth.
Maria: Which keys? need sampling and billing implications.
Sam: Canonical set: tenant -> X-Obs-Tenant, billing_key -> X-Obs-Billing, env -> X-Obs-Env, trace -> X-Obs-Trace, sample hint -> X-Obs-SampleHint.
Sam: Edge will inject X-Obs-* plus X-Obs-Orig-Keys (comma list) and will not drop originals in phase A.
Josh: Perf: header ops look cheap in microbench (<1% CPU at 1% rollout) but must canary. Also ensure cost-agg uses X-Obs-Billing to avoid double-counts.
Anya: Sampling: edge can decide consistently if we have canonical field. Surface original hint via X-Obs-SampleHint. Mark X-Obs-Sampled=true when sampled.
Kevin: Precedence if multiple sources disagree: client header > auth token claims > query param > none. Document it.
Maria: Migration plan: Phase A inject headers + metrics (canonical_pct), Phase B consumers prefer X-Obs_* + alerts on billing delta, Phase C deprecate originals after stable window.
Sam: Backfill: one-off transform over historical events to infer canonical keys and write canonical rows to billing table. Heavy but ok.
ingest-bot: Canary note: recommended pool = 1% of ingress. Create job obs-edge-header-canary.
Josh: I'll own perf/canary infra. Anya own analytics migration. Kevin own backfill. Sam/Maria drive RFC and rollout checklist.
Maria: OK to start Phase A next week? :rocket:
All: SGTM.
